hook: Your degree checks are clean. Your employment checks are not.
body:
Your degree checks are clean. Your employment checks are not.

Across white-collar hiring in India, employment verification now shows a discrepancy rate of 11.15%.

Address verification sits at 7.68%.

Most BGV budgets are still weighted towards education.

That is one in nine senior hires walking in on a claim nobody confirmed.

Where does your current check actually stop?
